caption: Internet linking with EchoLink or IRLP: your HT talks to a local repeater's node, your voice crosses the internet as data (VoIP), and a remote repeater puts you on the air in another part of the world.
spoken: A chain diagram: your handheld radio reaches a local repeater with an internet node, the internet carries your voice to a distant repeater, and a far-away ham hears you on their radio — EchoLink and IRLP style.
